mapper.select: select ds.id as stageId, ds.stage_code as stageCode, ds.stage_name as stageName, ds.stage_order as stageOrder, ds.stage_type as stageType, ds.organization_mode as organizationMode, ds.competition_format as competitionFormat, ds.execution_status as executionStatus, ds.execution_status as executionStatusName, ds.next_stage_code as nextStageCode, ds.advancement_type as advancementType, ds.advancement_count as advancementCount, ds.best_of as bestOf, case when ds.execution_status in ('RUNNING', 'RESULT_PENDING_CONFIRM') then 1 else 0 end as currentStage from basket_division_stage ds inner join basket_division_format_snapshot snap on snap.id = ds.snapshot_id and snap.is_current = 1 and snap.is_delete = 0 where ds.division_id = #{divisionId} and ds.is_delete = 0 order by ds.stage_order asc, ds.id asc

select ds.id as stageId, ds.stage_code as stageCode, ds.stage_name as stageName, ds.stage_order as stageOrder, ds.stage_type as stageType, ds.organization_mode as organizationMode, ds.competition_format as competitionFormat, ds.execution_status as executionStatus, ds.next_stage_code as nextStageCode, ds.advancement_type as advancementType, ds.advancement_count as advancementCount, ds.best_of as bestOf from basket_division_stage ds where ds.id = #{stageId} and ds.is_delete = 0 limit 1
select distinct coalesce(s.group_scope_key, 0) from basket_standing s where s.stage_id = #{stageId} and s.is_delete = 0 order by coalesce(s.group_scope_key, 0) asc

select s.rank_no as rankNo, s.event_team_id as eventTeamId, et.team_name_snapshot as teamName, et.team_logo_file_id as teamLogoFileId, s.win_count as winCount, s.lose_count as loseCount, s.point_for as pointFor, s.point_against as pointAgainst, s.point_diff as pointDiff, s.standing_points as standingPoints, s.stage_id as stageId, s.group_scope_key as groupId from basket_standing s join basket_event_team et on et.id = s.event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 where s.stage_id = #{stageId} and s.is_delete = 0 and coalesce(s.group_scope_key, 0) = coalesce(#{groupScopeKey}, 0) order by s.rank_no asc, s.id asc
